timestamp_note: System UTC at preregistration write; before executing noise and residual statistics.
known_prior_evidence: SMP errors and flux already corrected
baseline reproduction gate has not passed
population: Original release Hubble-sample DES CIDs matched by SNID, all 1635, compared to full public SMP and DIFFIMG photometry

off_signal.secondary_window: abs(MJD - published PKMJD) > 200 observer days; late Ia emission and contamination make this weaker
masks: basic valid finite flux, positive error, valid MJD
DIFFIMG: additionally exclude documented error bits 8,16,32,64,128,256,512,1024,2048 and enforce PSF FWHM0.5..2.75arcsec and electron-ZP>=30.5
SMP: basic only and diagnostic mask32+PSF/ZP; do not transplant DIFFIMG mask because published SMP accepts bits1024/2048
statistics: signed pull mean, median, RMS, standard deviation, robust MAD, fractions abs(pull)>3 and5
1000 object-cluster bootstrap intervals for mean, mean-square and tail fractions; no iid standard errors
object-band means and moments; distinct-time neighboring pairs with gaps 0..1,1..10,10..60,>60days and raw pull product (baseline offsets can mimic correlation)
strata: host surface-brightness magnitude<22,22..24,>=24 where positive host flux exists
off_signal.reference: Zero mean/unit variance Gaussian is a falsifiable working noise model, not assumed true. Population selected by Hubble sample, baseline contamination and common-reference offsets can falsify it without uniquely diagnosing photon-noise calibration.

published_residuals.method: Interpolate per-object/band published DATA_MODEL=0 flux curves only inside their time support, compare DATA_MODEL=1 and-1 separately; signed sqrt(published CHI2) additionally reports diagonal total-error residual diagnostic
published_residuals.caution: In-sample fit and clipping shrink/tail-truncate accepted residuals. CHI2 column is not full covariance quadratic. Neither diagnostic is an independent validation of SALT or Gaussianity.

pixel_access.population_rule: First three original DES Hubble CIDs in ascending numeric order with public survey coordinates, no selection on residuals
pixel_access.acquisition: Query documented public single-epoch SIA and image services. Acquire a small representative CCD stamp only when a documented cutout or efficient ranged FITS access exposes image plus weight/mask and usable WCS. Preserve URL/query/response/hash.
pixel_access.direct_test: For any usable calibrated CCD stamp: fixed sky/control apertures off known SN/host; compare summed sky-subtracted flux against weight-derived uncertainties with mask, PSF/WCS sanity and spatial correlation. If exact transient epoch or calibrated zero point unavailable, do not compare directly to released SMP amplitude. No coadd substituted for transient exposure; no image result if needed inputs inaccessible.

restrictions: No new SALT alternative fits before baseline gate
No cosmological bias claim from observational anomalies alone
Do not label calibrated flux raw detector pixels
